title: Over a height-one prime with DVR localization and analytically unramified quotient, the completion is a DVR at the associated primes of the extended prime
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/\mathfrak m^n$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be a prime ideal such that (1) the localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a discrete valuation ring, i.e. a Noetherian local integral domain whose maximal ideal $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$ is generated by a single nonzero element; and (2) $\mathfrak p$ is analytically unramified [def-weil-pbc-analytically-unramified], i.e. the $(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak p)$-adic completion of the local ring $R/\mathfrak p$ is reduced. Call a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset R^\wedge$ an associated prime of the $R^\wedge$-module $R^\wedge/\mathfrak pR^\wedge$ if $\mathfrak q=\{a\in R^\wedge: az=0\}$ for some $z\in R^\wedge/\mathfrak pR^\wedge$. Then for every such associated prime $\mathfrak q$ the localization $(R^\wedge)_{\mathfrak q}$ is a discrete valuation ring: a Noetherian local integral domain whose maximal ideal $\mathfrak q(R^\wedge)_{\mathfrak q}$ is generated by a single nonzero element.
